page_title: AUG 0-6 RBL | Augsburg v RB Leipzig 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
90+2' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig).
90+2' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle after Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Today's referee Daniel Siebert rightly decides to book Aiman Dardari (Augsburg) for his harsh tackle.
88' A player from RB Leipzig commits a rough challenge. Daniel Siebert blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

83' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
82' A pass by Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
82' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
80' Augsburg hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
77' Sandro Wagner has decided to make a change. Aiman Dardari (Augsburg) replaces Alexis Claude-Maurice.
77' Here's the change. Anton Kade leaves the pitch and Marius Wolf (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.

74' David Raum sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well over the bar.
73' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

72' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.
70' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Assan Ouedraogo is replaced by Andrija Maksimovic (RB Leipzig).
70' The referee signals a substitution. El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig) is brought on as a substitute for Willi Orban.
70' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
68' Daniel Siebert sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
67' Wait! Referee Daniel Siebert has indicated he is going to review the RB Leipzig goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
65' 0 - 6 Goal! Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 0:6.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for RB Leipzig.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) will replace Dimitrios Giannoulis.
65' A substitution has been made. Fabian Rieder is replaced by Ismael Gharbi (Augsburg).
64' Sandro Wagner has decided to substitute Elias Saad and he is replaced by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Christoph Baumgartner will be replaced by Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig).
63' Here is a change. Yan Diomande is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig).
63' The game has come to an end for Romulo Cardoso. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig).
62' A clever short pass gives Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
60' RB Leipzig are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
56' 0 - 5 Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the right post.
55' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
53' A snap shot by Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) from the edge of the area flies towards the top right corner, but Peter Gulacsi produces a good reflex save to thwart him.
51' Shots on target – 1:4.
51' Augsburg are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
49' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
47' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
46' Referee Daniel Siebert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Augsburg was in an offside position.
41' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Augsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by David Raum (RB Leipzig). Daniel Siebert saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
38' 0 - 4 Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way into the bottom right corner.
38' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
35' Augsburg hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
28' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
28' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle after Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
24' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
24' Poor challenge! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is penalised for tripping and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle.
22' 0 - 3 Goal! Yan Diomande provides Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 0:3.
18' 0 - 2 Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way into the bottom right corner.
16' Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.
14' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

10' 0 - 1 Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Finn Dahmen is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
8' Wasted effort! Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
3' Dangerous play by Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg). Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Augsburg keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
